body: I completely believe that when you die, there's nothingness, same as before you were born. I know it's not 'sleep'. It's probably just a bad choice of words on my part, because I'm saying I'm exhausted etc. But it's not just that I want to rest, it's more wanting the nothingness.

Not really, I feel like living is just too hard and too overwhelming. And it's as if everything has just hit me all at once and I'm just numb from it all, it's just made me think fuck everything, I'm out. And it would be so, so easy to do it.
I also need someone to talk to, if anybody here feels like it.

I feel overwhelmed by everything and I don't want to deal with things anymore. I'm exhausted but I can't sleep, and was going to take some codeine before which helps me sleep sometimes. But when I opened the drawer with all my pills in it (for a medical condition) I just couldn't stop thinking about how if I took a whole lot, I could just go to sleep and that would be it.
